changes.title: Singer alto
items: The singer sings lower and gentler: an alto in tune, in short steps, each note swelling in with a breath, with no chorus or octave smearing it; she sings only in the breakdowns and the builds now, as a small choir in the breakdowns, and comes back to the same motif each wave

changes.title: Flying cooldown slider
items: The pause page (Esc) has a slider for the flying cooldown: how long after landing before she can rise again

changes.title: Report button
items: The pause page's Circle report is now a general Report for any visual bug: it draws the paused frame with pairs of settings that should look the same, and saves where they differ along with her place and a link back to it
